head: a7376fc
milestone_full: Layer S continues: 183 Hong Kong chapters ship in three arms (Traditional HK / opencc Simplified fold / full English prose), with the atlas in lockstep at 183/183/183 and a derived fence. The five-chapter ticket arc (a nameless ticket found at Shui Chuen O, kept, waited with, given a second name, claimed, given a third, carried across the harbour at 23:05 to a terminus where another ticket is already waiting) is now a curated, server-rendered walk available from any of its chapters — no model, no network, no client state. Two real optimizations landed earlier: FactBundle lazy attribute index and mtime-cached ranking weights, per-request Python CPU ~107ms -> ~30ms. The stack was siege-tested at PRODUCTION rate limits: 2,702 credential-stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx, and the unscoped read plane stayed 244/244 OK at p50=8 ms THROUGHOUT the flood. Spring Cloud edge (Eureka / Config / Gateway / OpenFeign / LoadBalancer / resilience4j), 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics with password 123, an embedded handbook, and an English arm enforced by contract. The gpt-6.2-sol API was CLOSED by directive: all recent work is code-and-rules only, with no further live model claims. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 994 web tests, 38k AI tests green.
headline: 183 Hong Kong chapters in three arms · the ticket arc (179-183) made walkable · production-limit siege: 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244 · Spring Cloud edge + 12 StateGraph lanes · 994 web tests + 38k AI green · LLM API closed, no further live calls.
features: D1563: the ticket arc — five chapters (179-183), one object, a whole day, made walkable from any of its chapters; curated, server-rendered, local-only.
D1562: chapter 183 — the three-name ticket crosses the harbour at 23:05 and lands beside ANOTHER ticket already waiting at the Central terminus.
D1561: chapter 182 — the second name comes to claim the ticket; the count ripple caught and fixed a self-contradicting series claim.
D1541: siege re-measured at PRODUCTION limits — 10 grants then the 429 wall; stuffing 2,702 ALL 429 at p50=25ms; read plane 244/244 throughout, zero 5xx.

D1540: World Answer full-read tier (40x4000, the retrieval contract's own clamps) toward the 50k-token context goal; the live 50k measurement is pending — the key was exhausted and the API is now closed.
D1538: FactBundle lazy attribute index + ranking-weights mtime cache — per-request Python CPU ~107ms -> ~30ms, measured in-process with the lifespan actually run.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：183 章香港系列三語臂（繁體香港／opencc 簡體／完整英文），圖譜鎖步 183/183/183，圍欄數字由索引推導。五章「票之弧」——水泉澳邨街邊的無名票被拾起、留下、再等、寫上第二個名字、被認領、補上第三個名字、23:05 由夜車司機帶過海，落在中環終點站另一張仍在等認領的票旁——已成為可從任一章走完整條的路徑，全程服務端渲染、零模型、零網絡、零客戶端狀態。早前兩項真實優化落地：FactBundle 惰性屬性索引與排序權重 mtime 緩存，每請求 Python CPU 約 107ms → 約 30ms。以生產級限流實測攻城：2,702 發撞庫全部 429（p50=25ms、零 5xx），讀面在攻擊全程 244/244 全綠（p50=8ms）。Spring Cloud 邊緣（Eureka／Config／Gateway／OpenFeign／LoadBalancer／resilience4j）、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 的管理員行為分析、嵌入式說明書、契約測試強制英文臂。gpt-6.2-sol API 已按指令關閉：近期工作皆為純程式與規則，不再宣稱 live 模型能力。verify_all 全綠、web 994、AI 38k 全綠。
